title: 第二十三章掌控太阳星本源的金乌执掌于太古星辰的天帝第二十四章钟出天地惊太阳为兵星斗为阵
slug: 洪荒走向神话的大天尊
content_zh:
太阳星上，漫天火海渐渐平息，肆虐的毁灭之力也随之消散。
昊天的身影重新显现出来，浑身上下竟无一丝伤痕，便是那护身的光幕，亦完好无损。
“什么？这……怎么可能！”
陆压瞳孔骤缩，难以置信。方才那一击虽只是试探，却也倾注了太阳真火与太阳之道的精髓。
他虽不走以力证道的路子，却也是斩却一尸的准圣，更融合了父、叔二人的部分本源，实力远胜寻常准圣。可如此一击，竟连对方的防御都未能撼动分毫。
不止陆压，洪荒各方大能亦是一惊。此番结果，着实大出意料。
更令他们惊异的是——昊天方才根本没有动用天帝权柄。仅凭自身，便如此轻描淡写地接下了这一击。
昊天缓缓抬起手掌，掌心渐渐浮现一点光芒。那光芒迅速膨胀，化作一簇火焰，须臾之间便熊熊燃烧起来。火焰之上，道韵弥漫，玄奥莫测。
陆压瞪大了眼，众大能也张大了嘴。
只因昊天掌中之火，竟是太阳真火！那环绕其上的道韵，正是太阳之道！
须知，太阳真火除了以特殊手段驱使外，素来只有金乌一族能够掌控。太阳之道，亦为金乌一族专属的大道。昊天如何也能驾驭？
他登临天帝时不过大罗金仙，修行的又是至阳之道——虽与太阳之道有相通之处，却终究不是同一条路。他怎能如此轻易地掌御太阳真火？
“此人莫非身怀三足金乌血脉？”
此念一生，大能们皆是心头一跳。昊天的身份素来神秘，极少有人知晓他的根脚。难不成当初太阳星孕育的并非帝俊、太一二人，实则还有第三个，便是昊天？
“不，绝不可能。”三清与接引、准提纷纷摇头，“昊天绝非金乌血脉。此事多半与老师有关。”
太阳真火虽强，却并非金乌一族独有。圣人证道之后，自有办法掌控。昊天从前虽只是个童子，可他侍奉的乃是鸿钧道祖。有道祖暗中相助，助他掌控太阳真火，也并非不可能。
圣人们暗自感慨，看来还是小觑了这位小师弟。若真相果真如此，那道祖对昊天的看重，便远非他们先前所想那般简单。
怪不得当初道祖只给了昊天一个名号、两件灵宝，看似敷衍，如今想来，道祖极可能赐下了许多不为人知的底牌。
这位天帝，当真不简单。
太阳星上，陆压望着那熊熊燃烧的太阳真火与环绕其上的太阳大道，一时也愣住了。脑海中闪过无数猜测，看向昊天的眼神多了几分复杂。

莫非昊天也是金乌一族？
他这些年承受的打击实在太多。出生之时，妖族威震洪荒，只差一步便能执掌洪荒。
他身为太子，生来便受尽宠爱，享尽荣华。可就在最幸福的时刻，他亲眼看着九位兄长被射杀，又看着父母叔父陨落，妖族从此凋零。
他从九天之上跌落无尽深渊，一蹶不振，只能深藏于太阳深处熔炼本源，苦苦修炼，盼望有朝一日重振妖族荣光。
但他很快便清醒过来，金乌一族不可能有外人。即便有，那又如何？巫族的共工、祝融尚能手足相残，区区血脉又算得了什么？
不论昊天是何根脚，藏着什么秘密，今日他都必须击败对方，维护妖族的尊严！
content_en:
On the Sun Star, the sea of ​​​​fire gradually subsided, and the raging power of destruction also dissipated.
Haotian's figure reappeared, with no scars on his body, and even the protective light curtain was intact.
"What? This...how is it possible!"
Lu Ya's pupils shrank suddenly, in disbelief. Although the attack just now was just a test, it also contained the essence of the true fire of the sun and the way of the sun.
Although he did not follow the path of proving the Tao through force, he was still a quasi-sage who killed a corpse. He also merged part of the origins of his father and uncle, and his strength was far superior to ordinary quasi-sages. But such a blow could not even shake the opponent's defense in the slightest.
Not only Lu Ya, but all the great powers from all over the world were also shocked. This result was really unexpected.
What surprised them even more was that Haotian had not used the authority of the Emperor of Heaven at all just now. He took this blow so lightly just by himself.
Haotian slowly raised his palm, and a little light gradually appeared in his palm. The light expanded rapidly and turned into a cluster of flames, which burned blazingly in an instant. Above the flames, the Tao rhyme is permeated, mysterious and unpredictable.
Lu Ya's eyes widened, and all the powerful men also opened their mouths.
Just because the fire in Haotian's palm is actually the true fire of the sun! The Tao rhyme surrounding it is the Tao of the Sun!
It should be noted that except for the use of special means to control the True Fire of the Sun, only the Golden Crow clan has been able to control it. The Way of the Sun is also the exclusive avenue for the Golden Crow clan. How can Haotian control it?
When he ascended to the throne of Heavenly Emperor, he was no more than a Daluo Jinxian, and he practiced the Way of the Sun - although it was similar to the Way of the Sun, it was not the same path after all. How could he control the true fire of the sun so easily?
"Could this person have the blood of the three-legged Golden Crow?"
This thought will make the hearts of all powerful people skip a beat throughout their lives. Haotian's identity has always been mysterious, and few people know his origins. Could it be that the Sun Star gave birth to not only Di Jun and Tai Yi, but also a third one, Haotian?
"No, absolutely impossible." Sanqing, Jieyin, and Zhunti all shook their heads, "Haotian is definitely not of the Golden Crow bloodline. This matter is probably related to the teacher."
Although the true sun fire is strong, it is not unique to the Golden Crow clan. After the saint attains enlightenment, he has his own way to control it. Although Haotian was just a boy in the past, he served Taoist Hongjun. It is not impossible for Dao Ancestor to help him secretly and help him control the true fire of the sun.
The saints secretly lamented that they seemed to have underestimated this junior brother. If the truth is true, then the Tao Ancestor's regard for Haotian is far from being as simple as they thought before.
No wonder Daozu only gave Haotian a name and two spiritual treasures at the beginning, which seemed perfunctory. Now that he thinks about it, Daozu probably gave Haotian many unknown trump cards.
This Emperor of Heaven is really not simple.
On the Sun Star, Lu Ya was stunned for a moment as he looked at the blazing True Fire of the Sun and the Sun Avenue surrounding it. Countless speculations flashed through his mind, and the look he looked at Haotian was a little more complicated.
Could it be that Haotian is also from the Golden Crow clan?
He has suffered too many blows over the years. When he was born, the demon clan was so powerful that it was only one step away from taking control of the world.
As a prince, he was pampered and enjoyed all the glory from birth. But in the happiest moment, he watched his nine brothers being shot dead, and watched his parents and uncles die, and the demon clan withered from then on.
He fell from the nine heavens into the endless abyss and was unable to recover. He could only hide in the depths of the sun to smelt his essence and practice hard, hoping to one day regain the glory of the demon clan.
But he soon came to his senses. There could be no outsiders in the Golden Crow clan. Even if there is, so what? Gonggong and Zhu Rong of the Wu clan can still kill each other, so what does their mere blood mean?
No matter who Haotian is or what secrets he hides, he must defeat him today and maintain the dignity of the demon clan!
